content: ntHash rolling hash H(i)=rol*H(i-1) XOR rol^k*h(r[i-1]) XOR h(r[i+k-1]), O(n) regardless of k; canonical fwd+rc one loop. ntHash2 (Bioinformatics 2022) up to 2.1x faster, fixes k>64 rol^64=x collision bug (split rotation), canonical=sum(fwd,rc) not min. MIT github.com/bcgsc/ntHash. Prerequisite for minimizer computation; secondary speed lever (encoding cheaper at k21 than k31, so NOT the k21 differentiator). Rust: simd-minimizers, fracsync.
